user.title: Modbus Slave
user.description: Home Assistant will answer Modbus TCP requests for this slave ID on this port.

data.float_support: Master can read floating point values

data_description.host: IP address of this Home Assistant to listen on. Leave empty to listen on all interfaces.
data_description.allowed_ips: IP addresses or ranges (CIDR) that may connect, separated by commas, e.g. 192.168.1.10, 10.0.5.0/24. Leave empty to allow everyone.
data_description.float_support: Tick this if your PLC or SCADA can read 32-bit floats (often called REAL or FLOAT, 2 registers). Decimal values are then sent exactly. Leave it off if your master only reads whole numbers, or if you're not sure: values are then sent as whole numbers with a scale factor (21.5 °C → 215, the master divides by 10). Every master can read that. Changing this only affects new suggestions, not existing mappings.
data_description.share_usage: Off by default; nothing is sent unless you tick it. Please tick this: knowing how many installations are active and on which version is how I decide where maintenance and support time goes. When ticked, it sends every 6 hours only a random installation ID and the version of this integration; the server adds the country. Never addresses, entities, mappings or values. [Privacy statement]({site_url}/en/privacy/)

error.port_in_use: Port is in use or the address cannot be opened. Ports below 1024 need extra privileges on Container/Core installs; pick e.g. 5020. The listen address must belong to this Home Assistant.
error.invalid_allowed_ips: Use IP addresses or ranges like 192.168.1.10 or 10.0.5.0/24, separated by commas.
error.slave_id_in_use: Another Modbus Slave entry already uses this slave ID on this port. Pick another slave ID or port.
error.port_settings_differ: Other slaves on this port use a different listen address or allowed IPs. Slaves sharing a port share one listener: use the same settings, or another port.

abort.already_configured: This slave ID is already served on this port.

confirm.title: {entity}
confirm.description:
Now: {current} · Seen: {lo} … {hi} ({days} days)
Proposal: the master reads {registers} register(s) as {result_type}. {example_value} is sent as [{example_words}].

The proposal follows from your answers below. Change an answer and submit to see the new proposal. Writable: anyone who can reach this port can control this entity. Modbus TCP has no authentication.

data_description.negative: Tick if the value can drop below zero, e.g. an outdoor temperature or power fed back to the grid.
data_description.decimals: How many digits after the decimal point the master needs.
data_description.max_value: The largest value (ignoring the sign) it will ever reach. Pre-filled with room to spare from what Home Assistant has seen.

advanced.name: Advanced: choose the data type yourself

data_description.data_type: Automatic uses your answers above. Any other choice is used as given and the questions are ignored.

error.unsupported_entity: This entity has no on/off or numeric state.
error.type_mismatch: Use 'bit' for on/off entities and a numeric type for numeric entities.
error.not_writable: This entity cannot be controlled with this type. Writable: switch, light, input_boolean, fan (bit); number, input_number (numeric).
error.address_overlap: Address range overlaps the mapping of {conflict}.
error.value_too_large: This value does not fit, even in 2 registers. Keep fewer decimals, or enable floats for this server.
error.warn_negative: History shows negative values. Submit again to keep your choice.
error.warn_max: History shows higher values than this. Submit again to keep your choice.
error.result_changed: New proposal: {result_type}. Check it above and submit again to save.
